Class NeoForgeFluidStacks

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.util.NeoForgeFluidStacks
public final class NeoForgeFluidStacks extends Object
Boundary conversions between NeoForge's fluid value and the loader-neutral persisted representation. Both carry variant data as a DataComponentPatch, so the conversion is lossless.
